title: Displacement magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates displacement magnitude as √2 × R ≈ 70.7 m.

title: Displacement direction
description: Important: States displacement direction is from A to B, or describes it as 45° southwest/down-left.

title: Distance calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates distance as (3/4) × 2πR ≈ 235.5 m.

title: Arc length reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes distance equals arc length for 3/4 of circumference.

title: Units included
description: Optional: Includes correct units (meters) with numerical answers.

title: Confusing distance/displacement
description: Pitfall: Treats displacement as arc length or uses wrong fraction of circle.

title: Direction omission
description: Pitfall: Gives displacement magnitude without stating direction.
